scope: Swaps the llama.cpp serving weights from the pre-0731 unsloth UD-Q2_K_XL release to the 0731 release. This is the serving arm per results/DECISION-OVERRIDE.md; the ds4 arm is unaffected.

verification.power_loss_note: The box lost power mid-session on 2026-08-09. Both weight sets were fully re-hashed afterward rather than trusted on size, because a partially written shard fails silently.

sha256: 5475dce5d718...(truncated per repo digest policy; full values in git history of weights/unsloth-ud-q2_k_xl/manifest.json)

method.why_rename_not_overwrite: The incumbent shards are root-owned mode 0444 with link count 2. The second link is not visible from this account (find over /home/bmarti44 returns only the one path), so it is presumed to live under /home/dsv4. Overwriting in place would corrupt both links; renaming preserves the inode and leaves the other link intact.
method.why_no_root_was_needed: weights/unsloth-ud-q2_k_xl/ is bmarti44-owned and writable, and create/rename/unlink permissions derive from the directory, not the file mode.
steps: ln (hardlink) each staged 0731 shard to the canonical basename
rewrite weights/unsloth-ud-q2_k_xl/manifest.json with the 0731 digests under the canonical names
rewrite configs/pins/unsloth-ud-q2_k_xl.json to the 0731 source release
method.why_canonical_basenames: scripts/21_serve_llamacpp.sh hardcodes WEIGHTS_MANIFEST and verifies selected shards by basename, and scripts/52_engine_switch.sh does not pass MODEL_PATH through its env whitelist. Keeping the canonical names is what makes the swap a no-code change.

access_path_verified.note: Hardlinks retain the source inode's mode and ACL rather than inheriting the directory default ACL, so the chain was checked explicitly instead of assumed.

post_conditions.pre_existing_failure_note: test_frozen_profiles_pin_the_verified_production_candidates, test_glm_wrapper_hashes_the_selected_candidate_binary, test_glm_wrapper_rejects_unsafe_safety_overrides all fail identically with these changes stashed.

rollback.note: The *.gguf.pre0731 links were deleted at owner instruction once 0731 was serving. There is no longer a local rollback path: reverting to the pre-0731 release now requires re-fetching it from unsloth/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-GGUF at revision e3aa0d6a5fa4f820d9e132ac1fd1d01e1b2b49e0, whose per-shard sha256 values are preserved in the git history of weights/unsloth-ud-q2_k_xl/manifest.json (commit 72d1db7^).
rollback.disk_effect_measured: SUPERSEDED AND PARTLY WRONG -- see disk_effect_corrected_2026_08_10. Original text: 'Deleting the links freed 0 bytes. df reported 281G available immediately before and after. Each old shard had link count 2 and the surviving link is under /home/dsv4, which this account cannot read or unlink, so the ~90 GiB remains allocated until root removes that link.'

disk_effect_corrected_2026_08_10.correction: The /home/dsv4 hypothesis was wrong. A complete `sudo find / -xdev -type f -size 49437013568c` returns exactly four paths: the two pre-0731 copies under /var/lib/dsv4-context/models/, and two names for a single 0731 inode (6730860, link count 2) at weights/unsloth-ud-q2_k_xl/ and /home/bmarti44/models/dsv4-flash-0731-ud-q2k-xl/. No pre-0731 shard existed under /home/dsv4 or anywhere else on the filesystem.
disk_effect_corrected_2026_08_10.what_the_link_count_2_actually_was: The surviving link-count-2 pair belongs to the 0731 release -- the installed hardlink and its staging original, both under /home/bmarti44. Attributing a second link to the deleted *.pre0731 files and placing it under an unreadable directory was inference, not observation, and it was wrong.
disk_effect_corrected_2026_08_10.still_unexplained: Why df showed no change across the *.pre0731 deletion is not resolved. The files are gone and cannot be re-inspected, so no mechanism is being invented here. The measurement was taken at 1 GiB granularity (df -BG), which is the only identified weakness in it.

reclaim_verified_2026_08_10.cause: owner removed both /var/lib/dsv4-context/models/deepseek-v4-flash and its rotated-aside predecessor, 96832507552 bytes each
reclaim_verified_2026_08_10.side_effect: the protected context-qualification model copy is now absent, so scripts/64_context_submit.sh will re-copy it from the live 0731 weights on its next run rather than silently measuring the superseded release

remaining.restart: Requires one root command: scripts/52_engine_switch.sh uses install -o root and runuser -u dsv4. Until the engine is restarted it continues serving the pre-0731 weights already resident in memory (DSV4_NO_MMAP=1).
